Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk booking and check-in basics

This guide is here for travelers who need a fast, clear path when bringing a companion animal on Aurelia Skyways. Keep your documents ready, follow the calm handling steps, and move through each stage without delay.

For booking, make sure you use the required form and send only the details asked for. <<FACT F085>> After that, keep your confirmation close and review every line for accuracy before you travel. If you spot an error, contact the desk right away so it can be fixed before your trip starts.

At check-in, stay with your animal and follow the staff member's directions. Use a secure carrier or approved restraint, and do not rush the handoff. <<FACT F092>> If your pet seems uneasy, speak up early so the team can slow the process and use the most humane approach available.

Pack the basics in one easy-to-reach bag. Bring water, a familiar blanket, any needed papers, and a simple leash or carrier latch check. Keep food changes to a minimum on travel day, and avoid introducing anything new that could upset your animal. A calm routine helps the trip go more smoothly for everyone.

If you are traveling with Maggie or another pet, give yourself extra room to arrive early and settle in. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is set up to help travelers avoid confusion, reduce stress, and keep the handoff orderly from start to finish.

If anything changes before departure, tell the desk as soon as possible so the team can update the record and guide you on the next step. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly.
